earnings.title: Cerebras Systems Fast Inference Cloud Business Nearly Quadruples in Second Quarter 2026
highlights: GAAP cloud revenue grew 281%, core cloud revenue grew 287% from a year ago
Record GAAP cloud and other services revenue of $126.0 million, up 281% year-over-year; Record core cloud and other services revenue of $127.7 million, up 287% year-over-year.
GAAP total revenue of $180.1 million, up 74% year-over-year; Core total revenue of $209.9 million, up 103% year-over-year.
Core revenue of approximately $214 to $216 million
GAAP gross margin of 14%; Core gross margin of 41%, an improvement of approximately 940 basis points from Q2’25.

quotes.text: This was an outstanding quarter for Cerebras. Core revenue more than doubled to $210 million, and our cloud business nearly quadrupled year-over-year.
quotes.by: Andrew Feldman, Cerebras co-founder and CEO

quotes.text: Our quarterly results exceeded our guidance across all core business metrics. The market has responded strongly to the value of fast inference.
quotes.by: Bob Komin, Chief Financial Officer of Cerebras
